narrative.recommendations_md: Eight recommendations are presented in priority order, organized into three transformation phases. Each recommendation follows the mandatory structure: ROOT CAUSE (with evidence IDs confirming the gap) → SOLUTION (with named Zennify product) → EXPECTED OUTCOMES. Every recommendation is validated against Exchange Bank’s strategic objectives and identifies a named executive champion from Clay research.
narrative.roadmap_md: The roadmap sequences 8 recommendations into three phases, each building on the previous. Phase 1 creates the integration and data infrastructure that all subsequent clouds require. Phase 2 deploys revenue-generating Salesforce clouds. Phase 3 extends value into analytics, compliance automation, and citizen development. The phasing reflects Exchange Bank’s strategic priorities: CEO Sanderson’s dual-channel vision (Phases 1–2), Ganame’s data transformation agenda (Phases 1+3), and the 2024–2025 hiring surge readiness (all phases).
